verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has no documented white-label or embedded offering. There are only building blocks: open-source self-hosting with control over the URLs you expose, a management API, multiple-project clients, per-user concurrency keys, and realtime streaming to your frontend. One customer also reports powering their own AI automation platform on it. Together these suggest you can build customer-facing automation on top of it, but not embed the platform itself. Missing for 10: a documented white-label/embedding mode, embeddable or rebrandable customer-facing UI, multi-tenant end-customer workflow management, and hands-on evidence of white-label deployments.
